N23812822.raw_response: {"core_themes": "This folder contains joint weekly reports on Brazilian political affairs and relations, issued by the U.S. Department of State from September 1963 to January 1964. The reports survey current developments in the Goulart government, including cabinet-reform pressures, possible changes in ministerial appointments, political tensions in Congress, and maneuvering within the Partido Social Democrático (PSD) and Partido Trabalhista Brasileiro (PTB).
